# Sales Report Q1 2024

This document contains structured data including tables and lists.

## Monthly Breakdown

| Month    | Revenue | Expenses | Profit |
|----------|---------|----------|--------|
| January  | 50000   | 35000    | 15000  |
| February | 55000   | 37000    | 18000  |
| March    | 62000   | 40000    | 22000  |

## Product Categories

- Electronics: 45 percent of total revenue
- Software: 30 percent of total revenue
- Services: 25 percent of total revenue

## Regional Performance

| Region      | Q1 Revenue | Growth |
|-------------|------------|--------|
| North America | 89000    | 12 percent |
| Europe        | 45000    | 8 percent  |
| Asia Pacific  | 33000    | 22 percent |

## Key Observations

The Asia Pacific region showed the highest growth rate at 22 percent. This is driven by increased adoption of our software platform in Japan and South Korea.

North America remains our largest market with Q1 revenue of 89000 dollars.

We expect continued growth across all regions in Q2 2024.
